CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.

2. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

9. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)

   C. Remove the need for rules

----
